items.text: Deploying the application to automotive electronic control unit (ECU).
Refactoring some existing code from other language to Rust.
B.S. or higher degree in Computer Science, Electrical, Mechanical Engineering, or another related technical fields.
Experience of software development in Linux operating systems.
Solid programming technique in one of the following programming languages: C/C++/Java/Python.
Familiarity with the Rust programming language. (build systems, package managers, unit testing, integration testing).
Experience with embedded systems and cross-platform coding.

description.text:
Your Responsibilities
• Developing applications in Rust.
• Deploying the application to automotive electronic control unit (ECU).
• Maintaining and improving existing applications.
• Troubleshooting and resolving bugs.
• Refactoring some existing code from other language to Rust.
You Have
• B.S. or higher degree in Computer Science, Electrical, Mechanical Engineering, or another related technical fields.
• Experience of software development in Linux operating systems.
• Solid programming technique in one of the following programming languages: C/C++/Java/Python.
• Good communication and documentation skills.
Great to Have
• Familiarity with the Rust programming language. (build systems, package managers, unit testing, integration testing).
• Experience in functional programming languages.
• Experience with embedded systems and cross-platform coding.
• Familiarity with GitHub CI/CD.
